verdict.rationale: React is a library that is driven entirely through its documented public JavaScript API. Reference pages document entry points such as createRoot, hydrateRoot and the 'use client' directive, and an llms.txt index makes those docs machine-discoverable for AI-native use. There is no OpenAPI spec, but none is expected for a client-side library. missing for 10: evidence covering the breadth of the API reference beyond a few entry points, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use of the API.
